scientific_integrity: The infinite theorem has an explicit argument; finite exact-integer tests corroborate rather than certify the infinite statement. Prior inverse-degree and general spectral results are credited.
scientific_limitations: For the standard odd-cycle monomial Cremona family only. No classification of arbitrary monomial maps or higher dynamical degrees. The sources available with exact day-level public dates begin with the 2004 arXiv binomial-residue source; an older 2001 journal source is identified by year only. Full exclusion of uncatalogued overlap is not possible; no independent audit has occurred.
title: Antipodal convolution and reciprocal degree recurrences for inverse odd-cycle Cremona maps
